questions.text: In a Fire Safety Compliance Report, which fire-protection design item is source-safe under the checked RA 9514 RIRR family?

options.text: Water supplies, fire pumps, capacities, and hydraulic calculations for sprinkler or standpipe systems.
Only finish colors for pump-room walls.
Only the brand name of the selected pump.
A generic cost table without fire-protection criteria.

questions.text: Which standards relationship is source-safe for fire pump and sprinkler coordination under the checked RA 9514 RIRR family?

options.text: RA 9514 RIRR references NFPA standards such as NFPA 13, 14, 20, and 25 for applicable systems.
The RIRR says fire pumps never use referenced standards.
